During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team '''infiltrated''' the [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. They were attempting to find the missing Alliance [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Mors Odrion]], but did not find him at the base. The team, guided by a native [[Sedrian]] named [[Pek]], discovered evidence that [[Karak]], a [[Karak's renegades|renegade]] Sedrian, had made a deal with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Aban]] to split the power of the [[Golden Sun]] in exchange for Imperial support and weapons.<ref name="BGS" />
